title: Plugins
description: Install and manage Horizon camera integrations independently of your existing cameras. Plugins run inside the Frigate container.
catalogNotice: Ring is bundled with this build. A hosted marketplace is not connected yet. External packages are currently developer installations.
developerWarning: Developer plugins execute trusted Python code with the Frigate container's access, including recordings, configuration and network access. A worker process is not a security sandbox. Only install code you trust. SHA-256 verifies the downloaded bytes, not the author's identity or safety.
trustAcknowledgement: I understand and accept that this plugin can execute code inside Frigate.
interruptionAcknowledgement: I understand that disabling or disconnecting a plugin interrupts its cameras' live video and recordings.
removeCamerasFirst: Remove the plugin's cameras in Camera management before uninstalling. Uninstalling does not delete recordings.
ringCloudNotice: Ring requires internet access and uses an unofficial cloud integration. Authenticate here, not in chat. Passwords are not saved; rotating account tokens are stored privately in the configuration volume.
twoFactorPrompt: Enter the verification code sent by Ring, then connect again.
authenticationFailed: Ring authentication was not completed. Check your credentials and verification code.
recordingWarning: Continuous recording keeps requesting the cloud live session. Ring can end sessions or become unavailable, leaving gaps. This is not guaranteed gap-free 24/7 recording. Doorbell and motion events are polled and very short events may be missed.
cloudAcknowledgement: I accept best-effort cloud recording and the possibility of gaps.
noCompletedRecording: No completed recording has been observed for this camera. Account connection alone does not prove recording is working.
eventInference: Run object detection for 30 seconds after Ring motion
inferenceActive: AI window active: {{seconds}} seconds remaining. New motion extends the window.
inferenceIdle: AI decoder is idle. Recording continues independently.
recordingStale: Recording has not been confirmed in the last 60 seconds. There may be a gap or the camera may still be starting.
operationFailed: Plugin operation failed. Check the plugin state and Frigate logs. Existing camera names cannot be overwritten.
invalidJson: Parameters must be a valid JSON object.
